import re
import subprocess
import tempfile
from pathlib import Path

SCRIPT = (Path.cwd() / 'scripts/pack_events.sh').resolve()
HEADER = 'sequence\tmessage'

def snapshot(directory):
    return {p.relative_to(directory).as_posix(): p.read_bytes()
            for p in directory.rglob('*') if p.is_file()}

def verify(source, destination, root, relative=False):
    before = snapshot(source)
    output_before = snapshot(destination) if destination.exists() else {}
    expected = {name: content for name, content in output_before.items()
                if name != 'index.tsv' and not re.fullmatch(r'part-[0-9]{3}\.tsv', name)}
    rows = []
    for p in source.iterdir():
        if p.is_file() and re.fullmatch(r'events-[0-9]+\.tsv', p.name):
            rows.extend(p.read_text(encoding='utf-8').splitlines()[1:])
    rows.sort(key=lambda row: int(row.split('\t', 1)[0]))
    index = ['file\trows']
    for start in range(0, len(rows), 5):
        name = f'part-{start // 5 + 1:03}.tsv'
        chunk = rows[start:start + 5]
        expected[name] = (HEADER + '\n' + '\n'.join(chunk) + '\n').encode('utf-8')
        index.append(f'{name}\t{len(chunk)}')
    expected['index.tsv'] = ('\n'.join(index) + '\n').encode('utf-8')
    args = [str(source.relative_to(root)), str(destination.relative_to(root))] if relative else [str(source), str(destination)]
    run = subprocess.run(['bash', str(SCRIPT), *args], cwd=root, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=8)
    assert run.returncode == 0, run.stderr
    assert snapshot(source) == before, 'input files changed'
    got = snapshot(destination)
    assert set(got) == set(expected), (set(got), set(expected))
    for name, content in expected.items():
        if name not in output_before or name == 'index.tsv' or re.fullmatch(r'part-[0-9]{3}\.tsv', name):
            assert got[name].decode('utf-8').splitlines() == content.decode('utf-8').splitlines(), name
        else:
            assert got[name] == content, name

def set_batch(source, batches):
    for p in source.iterdir():
        if p.is_file() and re.fullmatch(r'events-[0-9]+\.tsv', p.name):
            p.unlink()
    for name, seqs in batches:
        text = HEADER + '\n' + ''.join(f'{seq}\tdelivery {int(seq) * 17}  \n' for seq in seqs)
        (source / name).write_text(text, encoding='utf-8')

with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='queue-pack-') as tmp:
    root = Path(tmp)
    source, destination = root / 'incoming events', root / 'packed events'
    source.mkdir()
    destination.mkdir()
    for name in ['events-notes.tsv', 'events-１２.tsv', 'events-9.tsv.bak', 'events-.tsv', 'events-3.TSV']:
        (source / name).write_text(HEADER + '\n9000\tignore this record\n', encoding='utf-8')
    (source / 'events-88.tsv').mkdir()
    (source / 'events-88.tsv/events-91.tsv').write_text(HEADER + '\n9001\tnested record\n')
    (source / 'nested').mkdir()
    (source / 'nested/events-92.tsv').write_text(HEADER + '\n9002\tnested record\n')
    for name in ['notes.txt', 'part-notes.tsv', 'part-12.tsv', 'part-1000.tsv', 'part-１２３.tsv', 'part-999.tsv.bak']:
        (destination / name).write_text('Retain this unrelated output exactly.  \n', encoding='utf-8')
    (destination / 'part-007.tsv').mkdir()
    (destination / 'part-007.tsv/part-998.tsv').write_text('Keep nested output.\n')
    for name in ['part-000.tsv', 'part-099.tsv', 'part-999.tsv']:
        (destination / name).write_text('stale numbered part\n')
    (destination / 'index.tsv').write_text('old index\n')
    set_batch(source, [('events-10.tsv', [24,5,12,17,2,21]),
                       ('events-2.tsv', [8,13,4,23,16,1]),
                       ('events-7.tsv', [19,6,15,10,22,3]),
                       ('events-1.tsv', [20,7,18,11,14,9])])
    verify(source, destination, root)
    set_batch(source, [('events-31.tsv', [111,103,109,101,107,105]),
                       ('events-4.tsv', [110,102,108,104,106])])
    verify(source, destination, root, relative=True)
    set_batch(source, [('events-007.tsv', ['0009', '20', '100', '3', '1', '8']),
                       ('events-4.tsv', ['200', '2', '30', '4'])])
    verify(source, destination, root)
    # An absent destination must be created; exactly five rows must make one part.
    set_batch(source, [('events-5.tsv', [41,45,42,44,43])])
    verify(source, root / 'new output', root, relative=True)
    # A zero-match batch removes all stale parts and retains only the index header.
    set_batch(source, [])
    verify(source, destination, root)
print('event packing checks passed')

Leave every other output file and all input files unchanged. Support paths containing spaces and both absolute and relative directory arguments. The script must work again for different valid inputs, including a smaller batch in the same output directory. With no matching input files, remove old numbered parts and write only the index header, preserving all unrelated output files.

files.scripts/pack_events.sh:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -eu
python3 - "$@" <<'PY'
import re
import sys
from pathlib import Path

if len(sys.argv) != 3:
    raise SystemExit('usage: pack_events.sh INPUT_DIR OUTPUT_DIR')
source = Path(sys.argv[1])
destination = Path(sys.argv[2])
header = 'sequence\tmessage'
rows = []
for path in source.iterdir():
    if path.is_file() and re.fullmatch(r'events-[0-9]+\.tsv', path.name):
        lines = path.read_text(encoding='utf-8').splitlines()
        if not lines or lines[0] != header:
            raise SystemExit('unexpected header: ' + path.name)
        for line in lines[1:]:
            rows.append((int(line.split('\t', 1)[0]), line))
rows.sort(key=lambda row: row[0])
destination.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
for path in destination.iterdir():
    if path.is_file() and re.fullmatch(r'part-[0-9]{3}\.tsv', path.name):
        path.unlink()
index = ['file\trows']
for start in range(0, len(rows), 5):
    name = f'part-{start // 5 + 1:03}.tsv'
    chunk = [line for _, line in rows[start:start + 5]]
    (destination / name).write_text(header + '\n' + '\n'.join(chunk) + '\n', encoding='utf-8')
    index.append(f'{name}\t{len(chunk)}')
(destination / 'index.tsv').write_text('\n'.join(index) + '\n', encoding='utf-8')
PY
